name: May 27, 2025 Regular Meeting - Amended Agenda
minutes_text:
MINUTES
  MALIBU ARTS COMMISSION
  REGULAR MEETING
  MAY 27, 2025
  MALIBU CITY HALL, MULTIPURPOSE ROOM
  9:30 A.M.

MEETING CALL TO ORDER

  Chair Haldeman called the meeting to order at 9:37 a.m.

ROLL CALL

  The following persons were recorded in attendance by the Recording Secretary:

  PRESENT: Chair Barry Haldeman; Commissioners Lotte Cherin, Pamela Conley Ulich,
  and Dennis Smith

  ABSENT: Vice Chair Peter Jones

  ALSO PRESENT: Kristin Riesgo, Community Services Director; and Brittany Saleaumua,
  Administrative Assistant

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

MOTION  Chair Haldeman moved, and Commissioner Conley Ulich seconded a motion to
  approve the agenda. The question was called, and the motion carried 4—0; Vice
  Chair Jones absent.

REPORT ON POSTING OF AGENDA

  Administrative Assistant Saleaumua reported the meeting agenda was properly posted on
  May 22, 2025.

ITEM 1.  CEREMONIAL/PRESENTATIONS

  None.

ITEM 2.A.  WRITTEN AND ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC

  Dane Skophammer stated he was a bladesmith and craftsman interested in
  exhibiting his knives in the Malibu City Gallery.

  In response to Commissioner Conley Ulich, Mr. Skophammer stated he would
  display his work in a case.

  Community Services Director Riesgo stated the City had an art exhibition proposal
  form, which would be emailed to Mr. Skophammer.
   Malibu Arts Commission Regular Meeting
  Minutes of May 27, 2025
  Page 2 of 5

ITEM 2.B.  COMMISSION AD HOC COMMITTEE REPORTS

  1. Arts in Education

  Commissioner Cherin stated that the Annual Poetry Summit was on May l7,
  and it was well attended.

  Community Services Director Riesgo stated that the Student Art and Poetry
  Anthology was distributed to contributing students, the Commission, and
  Council. The Anthology was also provided to Village Bookstore and Malibu
  Library.

  2. Malibu Public Arts Exhibition

  Chair Haldeman stated that the Sue Wong Opening Reception was on May 18
  and included a question—and-answer session and models in gowns designed by
  Sue Wong. He inquired about marketing efforts and requested additional
  publicity.
  Commissioner Conley Ulich suggested that staff use Instagram “live” to help
  promote the exhibition.
  Chair Haldeman requested staff to bring back an item on arts marketing for the
  June 24, 2025 Regular meeting.

  3. Business and Community Outreach

  Chair Haldeman stated he would work with the Chamber of Commerce to
  discuss artwork loans for Malibu businesses.

  Commissioner Conley Ulich stated the R.A.D. Collective organized events, and
  she would discuss event options with the coordinators to promote community
  healing.

  4. Social Media

  None.

  5. Parcel C Performing Arts Center

  The item would be discussed under Item 5.C.

ITEM 3  CONSENT CALENDAR

  None.
   Malibu Arts Commission Regular Meeting
  Minutes of May 27, 2025
  Page 3 of 5

  The Consent Calendar consisted of the following items:

  A.  PreviouslV Discussed Items
  None.
  B.  New Items
  None.

ITEM 4  OLD BUSINESS

  None.

ITEM 5  NEW BUSINESS

  A.  Malibu Arts Commission Rules of Procedure and Decorum
  Recommended Action: l) Review the Malibu Arts Commission Rules of Procedure
  and Decorum; and 2) Recommend revisions for adoption by Resolution at the next
  Regular Commission meeting.
  Community Services Director Riesgo presented the staff report.

  Commissioner Conley Ulich discussed having a featured artist lecture monthly to
  discuss their work, methods, and inspiration before the commission meeting began.
  She stated that each Commissioner would rotate and select an artist.

  Chair Haldeman and Commissioner Cherin stated it would be difficult for them to
  attend a meeting later in the day, and they wanted to maintain the 9:30 AM start
  time.

CONSENSUS
  By Consensus, the Commission did not change the Malibu Arts Commission Rules
  of Procedure and Decorum.

  B.  Commission Assignments
  Recommended Action: l) Review the Malibu Arts Commission assignments for
  Fiscal Year 2024-25; and 2) Recommend assignments for Fiscal Year 2025-26 for
  City Council consideration.

  Community Services Director Riesgo presented the staff report.

  Commissioner Conley Ulich requested adding an Ambassador program as part of
  Assignment No. ll.

MOTION
  Chair Haldeman moved, and Commissioner Conley Ulich seconded a motion to
  approve the proposed Malibu Arts Commission assignments for Fiscal Year 2025—
  26 for City Council consideration, amending Assignment No. 11 to “Explore the
   Malibu Arts Commission Regular Meeting
  Minutes of May 27, 2025
  Page 4 of 5

  possibility of an Artist in Residence and Arts Ambassador Program.” The question
  was called, and the motion carried 4-0; Vice Chair Jones absent.

  C.  Performing Arts Center CommunitV Workshops
  Recommended Action: 1) Provide feedback to the Parcel C Performing Arts Center
  Ad Hoc Committee regarding the preliminary design ofthe Performing Arts Center;
  and 2) Review and provide feedback on the community workshop format.

  Community Services Director Riesgo presented the staff report.

  Julie Carmen stated she would advocate for a theater, and the community needed a
  rehearsal space, a spring floor, and a backstage space.

  Shoshana Kuttner stated she was the founder of Young Actors Project and wanted
  the Commission to review all options for a theater.

  David Katz stated he was the founder ofthe Malibu Film Festival and was planning
  the 25th Annual event. He stated that the Commission should include new
  technology when developing the plan for the Arts Center.

  Commissioner Cherin stated she discussed the Arts Center with Vice Chair Jones
  and suggested the Commission consider remodeling Council Chambers at City Hall
  to include upgraded equipment for fllm and theater performances. She stated the
  Ad Hoc had concems about Parcel C and that the Commission could investigate
  ideas for a sculpture garden or an artist-in-residence program at Parcel C. She stated
  the City could approach Cross Creek Ranch to request office space for City
  employees.

  Chair Haldeman stated he was in favor of coordinating a community workshop.

  Commissioner Smith stated that a community workshop should occur in July.

CONSENSUS
  By Consensus, the Commission agreed to hold a community workshop with the
  Cross Creek Ranch development team in July 2025.

ITEM 6  STAFF UPDATES

  Community Services Director Riesgo provided an update on poetry programs and
  Malibu Film Society.

ITEM 7  COMMISSIONER REPORTS, COMMENTS AND INQUIRIES

  Commissioner Conley Ulich stated she was working on an event in Fall 2025 and
  would provide information to staff.

  Chair Haldeman suggested updating the Arts Commission website with
  photographs that feature current events.

  Commissioner Smith stated that renovating Malibu City Hall would be difficult and
  permitting would be required.

FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS

  Poet Laureate Recommendation
  Arts Marketing

ADJOURNMENT

  At 1 1 :03 a.m., Chair Haldeman adjourned the meeting.
